stories.title: Show HN: Subvocal – Talk to your computer without making noise
summary: It's a bit weird to do, but with practice, we have been able to get it down pretty well.)Arnav and I were studying CS at Georgia Tech at the beginning of the year, with no experience in silent speech or sensing.
We built a crude prototype, sticking EMG electrodes onto my face:https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mwhv5HZMz3UTevdrgwS5O7g2jWV...We got it to kind of work at a letter level in a very janky way.
We set up booths in our office and paid people to read prompts wearing our glasses, to pretrain our models on.
